_deal: The remote planet pool, as remote02a to 05a.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-19 21:5x: "lets do a dungeon mixed with the wave defense, so forces raid after you. Make it so boss has item then another squad turns up ti take it."
_note: THE NAV CORE. A dungeon and a hold in one: take the item off the boss, then the rest of his crew lands and comes
in after you for it. The waves are the boss's own gang coming back, because a hold draws from the base driver's
list and cannot name another (a rival force would need a hold that takes its own enemies list: Eliza's, if he
wants it). Remote, so no drive. The hold's pity point is the boss marker: a wave that cannot reach him forms
where the fight was, so the lint's one-spot-two-beats warning is deliberate. Pay med, under his cap.

place._theme: A dungeon: the boss marker is the only stop, so any place carrying one can draw it. ⚠ Waves inside an interior are new (every hold so far was outdoors): they spawn 30 to 100 m from him snapped to navmesh, which indoors may be another room. His play decides; the stuck guard lets a wave go at 180 s either way.

prose.name: Recovery: Stolen Nav Core on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders boarded a freighter, took what they could carry and her nav core with it. Their boss is at the <Place>. Without the core, her captain isn't going anywhere.

beats.objective: Take the nav core from the boss at the <Place>
beats.journal: I took the freighter's nav core off the raiders' boss at the <Place>. Now the rest of the crew will want it back, and I need to hold on to it.
say: That's my core. Don't get comfortable. The rest of them will be back for it.

beats.objective: Hold on to the nav core
beats.revealObjective: Stop the rest of the crew taking the core
beats.journal: Raiders at the <Place> had a freighter's nav core. I took it off their boss, and when the rest of the crew came back for it, I kept it. Her captain is sending someone for it.
say: That's the last of them. I'll send someone for the core.

broadcast: They boarded us, took what they could carry, and the nav core with it. Without that core my ship's a very expensive tent. Their boss has it. Get it back before they work out what it's worth.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, places, factions or currency. Voice is remote05b's 'Daniel, Steady Broadcaster', used once so far; his ear decides.
